༄༅/ /ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i chos skor gyi byung tshul mdo tsam brjod pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i chos skor gyi byung tshul mdo tsam brjod pa bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ rgyal mchog thugs rje'i 'od dkar phreng ba rgyas/ /skal ldan blo yi ku mud kha phye las/ /legs bshad ge sar rgod pa'i rdul 'phreng dag /blo ldan gtsug gi nor bus ngal gso byos/ /'dir myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i byung tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ ye shes kyi mgon po nyid kyis khyad par gyis thugs bskyed tshul/ sgrub thabs kyi chos skor 'phags yul du byung tshul/ de las brgyud de kha ba can gyi ljongs su dar tshul/ da lta grags che ba'i chos skor rnams ji tsam yod pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sngon thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis dang po thugs bskyed pa nas bzung*/ bskal ba grangs med mang por tshogs bsags/ sa bcu pa khyad par can brnyes/ 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur thob/ rgyal sras thu bo rnams kyi gral du tshud pa'i skabs shig thugs bskyed kyi dam bca' 'di lta bu mdzad de/ phyogs bcur rab 'byams mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'khor ba'i gnas 'di dag gi sems can gyi don bya ste/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las bdag gis sgrol ba las/ 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la ma 'khod kyi bar du bdag sangs rgyas thob par mi bya/ sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa sangs rgyas la bkod zin pa na/ de'i rjes su bdag nyid sangs rgyas thob lags kyi/ gzhan du na bdag 'khor ba nyid du gnas te sems can gyi don bya'o/ /gal te bdag dam bca' 'di las 'da' bar gyur na lus tshal pa stong du 'gas par gyur cig /ces dbu snyung mdzad do/ / de nas brtsams te ri bo po ṭa lar bzhugs nas sprul pa mtha' yas pas skad cig re re la yang sems can dpag tu med pa cig car smin grol du mdzad na gzhan lta ci smos/ tshul de lta bu'i lo grangs kyi tshad bzung bar ga la nus/ bskal ba rang yang ji snyed cig song ba na/

dus lan gcig da ni sems can mang po grol byung bas 'khor ba'i gnas stongs las che dgongs te mngon shes kyis gzigs pas/ sems can gyi khams la 'phel 'grib med pas nyung bar ma zad/ yul nye ba na gnas pa'i sems can rnams snyigs ma lnga bdo bas 'dul dka' ba rnams gzigs te/ da ni bdag gis sems can gcig gi don yang byar mi nus zhes sngar gyi thugs bskyed dam bca' de btang ba'i tshul mdzad pas sku lus tshal ba stong du gas skad/ 'phags pa 'jig rten mgon po de nyid dang po thugs bskyed pa nas bzung ste rtag tu rjes su bzung ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med yin pas/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mngon sum du byon nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi de lta bu'i sems bskyed btang ba de ma legs/ da ni dam bca' btang ba de slar gso ba sogs kyi don du sngar gyi sems bskyed pa de bas rgya che ba'i sems bskyed zhig gyis shig ces gsungs shing sku lus tshal pa stong du gas pa de dbu bcu gcig dang phyag stong phrag tu byin gyis brlabs so/ /der dgongs pa la sngar gyi de bas rgya che ba'i sems bskyed ni nam yang med/ de'i cha shas kyang sgrub par mi nus zhes zhag bdun ci bya rtol med pa las/ de'i tshe da ni snyigs ma lnga bod pa'i sems can ma rungs pa rnams drag pos 'dul ba dang*/ chos byed rnams kyang bar do'i 'jigs pa las mi thar par gzigs nas bar do las skyob pa dang*/ snyigs dus skye bo rnams dbul phongs kho na sdug bsngal che bas/ de'i gnyen por bsam pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba ste/ 'phrin las rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas thugs bskyed snga ma las lhag pa'i tshul du dgongs te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs ka nas hūṃ mthing nag gcig byung ste/ de nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon por gyur pa na zhing khams thams cad du sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/

/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhal nas mgrin gcig tu rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di lta bu'i sems bskyed pa de legs so/ /myur mdzad mgon po 'di la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'di nyid kyis dbang dang ldan par bya'o/ khro bo gshin rje gshed po 'di nyid kyis mthu dang ldan par bya'o/ /gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang/ gshin rje dang*/ bdud dang ma mo'i tshogs kyis 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyis sprul pa'i khro bo chen por dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol lo/ /de nas brtsams te sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad du bstan pa bsrung zhing bzhugs pa lags/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du gshegs pa na/ gar mkhan zhig dad pa skyes te glu dang rol mo'i mchod pa rgya cher phul nas smon lam btab/ de nas phyis sangs rgyas sku mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya nye bar lon pa ni mi'i skye ba brnyes shing grub pa thob pa'i ri khrod mgon po shā ba ri pa zhes bya bar gyur/ de lan gcig dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal na spros pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i skabs nangs zhig tho rangs nam mkhar ḍā ma ru'i sgra khrol byung ba la gshegs pas ye shes kyi mgon po 'di mngon sum du byon 'dug te/ mgon pos nyid kyi srog sngags dang sgrub thabs thams cad grub thob shā ba ri pa la gnang ngo*/ /dpal ldan shā ba ri pa de rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa yin no/ / gzhan yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ 'phags ma sgrol ma/ dpal mgon po nyid de/

byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi 'bral med bya ba yin te/ shā ba ri pa la lha gzhan de rnams kyis kyang rang rang so so'i sgrub thabs gsungs so/ /dus skabs de nas lo stong phrag tsam lon pa'i dus phyis/ mnga' bdag mai tri ba zhes bya ba mtshan dngos mai tri gu bhe bod skad du byams pa sbas pa/ gsang mtshan gnyis med rdo rje ces bya ba de bi kra ma shī lar bzhugs dus bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob/ nus mthu khyad par can brnyes kyang gnas lugs kyi don ma rtogs nas lhag pa'i lha la gsol ba btab pas/ lho phyogs dpal gyi rir songs shig ri khrod mgon pos rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan thob/ de nas dpal rir byon/ grub thob shā ba ru pa las zab mo'i don gyi phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa mtha' dag gsan/ gnas lugs gzigs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par 'gyur/ zab don gyi gdams pa spel ba'i bka'i gnang ba thob/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs brtsams/ zhag nyer gcig bsgrubs pas chos skyong bran du 'khol bar gyur te/ dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol nas brtan g.yo'i dngos po chen po blang te 'bul ba sogs bzhed don mtha' dag sgrub pa zhig go / yang gtam rgyud kyi rnam grangs gzhan ni/ sngon dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go cha lcags kyi byin pa can du grags pa de ri po ṭa lar lan gsum byon/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos su mjal/ snga phyi pho brang gzhal med khang gzhan thams cad la mjal zhing bskor/ rten kun la yang phyag mchod bsgrubs pa las/ mtha' gcig na khang bzang shin tu che ba nam yang sgo mi 'byed pa zhig 'dug te/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la 'di'i sgo 'byed par zhu zhus pas/ 'di'i sgo phye na 'jig rten gsum po thams cad sngangs shing 'chi pa'am 'chi la thug par 'gyur gsungs pas/ yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid la zhus shing gsol ba btab pas sprul pa'i pho nya zhig mngags te/

'phags pa'i bkas gnang ba'i stobs kyis sems can su la gnod pa med pa'i ngang nas sgo phyes/ der ye shes kyi mgon po 'di dang mjal/ gsol ba btab pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ 'dzam bu'i gling du sems can gyi don dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba la 'byor bar zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas bzung dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal shing n+ya gro dha'i phug na sprul pa'i sku zhig rtag tu bzhugs pa yin/ sa ra ha dang shā ba ri bas sgrub thabs kyang mdzad ces grags te/ 'di lo ts+tsha ba 'gar chos bzang gi lugs kyi gsung sgros las byung*/ po ṭa la'i lam yig tu grags pa'i rgyud las kyang po ṭa lar mgon po 'di bzhugs par bshad pa dang mthun no/ / yang 'ga' zhig 'di lta ste/ mgon po 'di dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten na bzhugs pa slob dpon klu sgrub dang*/ bram ze mchog sred kyis spyan drangs zhes kyang bzhed de/ de thams cad yul dus gnas skabs so so yin pa'i phyir thams cad don la gnas shing bden pa kho na'o/ / gsum pa ni/ spyir mgon po 'di'i chos skor bod du bsgyur ba'i lots+tsha ba mang du byung ste/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis pan+ṭi ta mi mnyam rdo rje'i khol po la gsan nas shā ba ri pa'i gzhung chung bsgyur/ lugs 'di mgon rkyang kho nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi chos skor yin par grags so/ /mnyam sring lo tsā ba gang rung tshul khrims 'byung gnas zhes bya bas paṇ+ḍi ta shan ta a ka ra la brten nas bsgyur zhes grags shing*/ 'di'i sgrub thabs bod kyi yig rnying ci rigs par mthong te/ mkha' 'gro drug skor du grags pa de yin par 'dug /yang lo ts+tsha ba 'gar chos bzang gis paṇ+ḍi ta a ta ya badz+ra la gsan te sa ra ha dang*/ shā ba ri'i sgrub thabs bsgyur/ 'gyur 'di la 'khyud yum yod med gnyis yod na'ang 'khor mkha' 'gro bzhi skor kho na yin/

khyung po'i gdams ngag dang mthun shas che ba zhig yod/ kha cig a ta ya zhes pa yi ge nor ba yin/ a ta ya badz+ra zhes pas gnyis med rdo rje me tri ba dang gcig zer ba ni blos btags pa tsam ste a ta ya zhes kun tu sbyin pa'am mchog tu byams pa'i don yin no/ /yi ge ta dang da nor so tsam byung srid kyang yul skad gyi khyad par dag las 'gal ba yang med cing*/ spyir yang yig nor dang bsdu yig la dgag sgrub dgos na ha cang thal bar 'gyur ro/ /mi mnyam rdo rje dang a ta ya badz+ra 'di gnyis kar mkhas grub khyung po'i yang bla ma yin no/ / de ltar yang lugs de dag la ni bsnyen bsgrub las gsum cha tshang tsam mdor bsdus te ma gtogs chos skor rgyas pa med/ deng sang chos rgyun yang mi bzhugs so/ /des na mgon po 'di'i chos skor rgyas shing zab pa bcos bslad dang bral ba byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'gran zla med cing sa steng thams cad khyab pa'i 'phrin las kyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa ni mkhas grub byung po'i rnal 'byor ba 'di'i man ngag kho na yin no/ /de yang mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor pa de gdung rus khyung po 'khrung yul snye mo ra mang*/ dang po bon la mkhas par mdzad de tshogs pa bdun brgya tsam 'dus/ de nas rdzogs chen la zhugs te slob ma sum brgya tsam 'dus/ de nas skor de mtshams nas bla ma mang du bsten te/ kye rdor dang gshin rje gshed dang phyag chen gyi skor mtha' dag gsan/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga gnyis tsam bzhes pa la bal yul du phebs te/ de nas kyang mi lo lnga bcu'i skor rgya bal bod gsum du 'byon bzhud mdzad/ bla ma rgya gar ba mkhas pa brgya dang lnga bcu bsten/ mdo sngags sgra tshad gzhung man ngag thams cad thugs su chud par mdzad/ thun mong gi bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chen po bsod nams 'byung gnas/ mai tri ba/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ ra hu la pa de bzhi dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu dang*/

su kha sid+dhi ste drug po rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma mdzad/ de la rgya gar du lan bar ma phebs pa'i tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gnyis sogs mkhas grub dpag tu med pa'i thugs bcud longs/ slar bod du ldog tu nye ba'i skabs zhig mnga' bdag mai tri ba la chos rgyag gi lhag ma gser mang du yod pa rnams phul te/ bdag cag bod rnams longs spyod chung bas nor sgrub myur la ltag tshan che ba zhig zhu zhus pas/ mgon po'i 'di'i sngon gyi lo rgyus rnams gsungs te/ thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ mgon po shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ 'di dang po rten pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba/ bsam pa tsam gyi bar chad thams cad sel ba/ dgra thams cad rdul du rlog par byed pa/ gsol ba btab nas ma bsgrubs par yang zhal ston pa/ bzlog pa dang nang rmes mi tshugs pa/ thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhor la 'byung ba/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i chos skyong 'di sbyin pa bya zhes gsungs te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang zab mo'i sgo phye nas chos skyong 'di'i gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang zhing mthar 'di skad ces/ spyir dam tshig ma nyams pa/ dgos su 'bru nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang thun mong ma yin pa'i spos sbyor sogs dam rdzas rnams tshang zhing ma 'chags pa/ bya nag dang khyi nag la rdos mi rdeg pa dang*/ yid ches par byed pa sogs mgon po'i dgos kyi dam tshig rnams la'ang gnas par gyis/ de ltar byas na ri la sdod pa sogs gnas skabs thams cad du 'tsho ba'i rtsol ba mi dgos/ rang la dgos tshad mgon po rang gi skyel/ zhag bcu gsum bsgrubs na khyod nyid 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la'ang zhal mngon sum du ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan mdzad de/ de nas bod du byon yang slad kyi rgya gar du phebs te bla ma rnams kyi sku drin dran pa'i tshogs 'khor zhu ba dang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal bzang pos mnyes par mdzad/

de skabs mnga' bdag mai tri ba ni mi bzhugs/ jo mo rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ma gang ga dha ri'i drung du gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul bas kyang phyag chen dang*/ mgon po las dngos grub 'grub pa'i ltas khyad par can brnyes/ de rjes slar bod du phebs shing 'gro don kyang cher mdzad/ bar bar du sgom sgrub tshul yang mang du bstan/ sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' yin nges par dgongs nas dge bshes po to ba dang*/ glang ri thang pa la'ang chos gsan/ 'phan yul jog pa'i ri la gcig ril mdzad/ dang po bla ma mai tri pas gsung dus 'tsho ba'i rtsol ba mi dgos mgon pos skyes gsung dgongs te/ 'tsho ba'i rtsol ba yem mdzad pas 'tsho ba chad/ nub gcig mgon po'i rgyun gtor yang ma byung bas phug pa'i sgor thon te/ k+ṣe tra pā la sogs mgon po'i las mkhan rnams kyi ming nas bos te/ dang po bla ma mai tri bas de skad gsung ba yin te/ da 'di na nga la 'tsho ba nam yang med/ mgon po rang gi rgyun gtor yang chad nas med do/ /zhes gsungs skad chen po btang bas de'i nang bar rang 'bras khongs kyi tshong 'dus nas 'bul skyel ba shin tu tshab che ba byung ste/ mar/ nas dang*/ ja zas gos sogs shin tu mang po byung ste/ de la brten nas slob ma mang du bsdus nas chos gsung*/ zla gcig tsam song nas tshogs mang ches te/ jog por ma shong nas lung pa'i mda' chad ka zhes bya bar dgon pa btab/ rim gyis tshogs pa stong tsam 'dus/ de nas lan gcig dgon pa'i nang gi spyil bu zhig tu bzhugs/ zla stod grol mtshams byed kyin chos bshad/ zla smad la mtshams mdzad cing yod pa las mtshams kyi dus zhig nam langs ma thag gzim khang gi sgo rdung ba zhig byung bas/ nye gnas kyis bltas dus a tsa ra zhig byon 'dug nas bla ma dang mjal bar zhu gsung ba na/ de nas yar lon mar lon byas te/ mtshams la yod pas mi mjal zhus pas nga thag ring po nas 'ongs pa'i nad pa zhig yin pas cis kyang mjal ba zhu gsung*/

de nas nang du spyan drangs sman pa bos te blta ru bcug pas/ 'di khrag tu 'dug te gtar kha bya dgos zer ba la/ rnal 'byor pas gtar kha des mi yong gsung te rlung sbyor zhig mdzad pas/ khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la 'u ru 'u ru bzhugs te ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nad khrag rnams phyir byung*/ der bser ma langs gsung gin 'dug pas 'bru mar gyi byugs pa 'bul bar brtsams pa na/ rnal 'byor pas bsku mnye des mi yong gsung*/ yang rlung sbyor gzhan zhig mdzad pas/ de sngar bzhin nam mkha' la 'u ru 'u ru 'dug pa las ba spu'i bu ga nas kun da zhag dang bcas pa snum tshil gyis byung*/ yang rlung sbyor gzhan zhig mdzad pas ba spu'i bu gar sib sib thim pas sku bkrag mdangs dang ldan par gyur te/ de ngo mtshar che bar mkhyen nas/ da nang gang nas phebs zhus pas/ nga rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas da nang nyi ma shar ma thag 'ongs pa yin te/ po ta ri rong dog pas 'dir slebs dus nyi ma ma shar bar 'dug gsung*/ mtshan gang yin dri bas ra hu la gup+ta badz+ra yin gsungs te gu na pā ka ra dang*/ rat+na a kā ra dang*/ yang a bhi dzu ta ka na re/ bod du song dang rnal 'byaur pa zhig la phan thogs par 'gyur zhes gsung te 'ong bas khyaud dang 'phrad pa yin/ ces sogs bla ma nyid kyi rnam thar rgyas par gsung*/ de nas mkhas grub khyung po nyid kyis bla ma ra hu la pa de la rgyud man ngag spyi la grags pa mtha' yas pa gsan/ khyad par na mgon po 'di'i chos skor shin tu rgyas pa/ gsan te/ sngar mnga' bdag mai tri ba la mi bzhugs pa'i khyad par gyi gdams pa yang mang du byung*/ gnas der zla ba bdun bzhugs/ de nas klu shod dang*/ rong dang*/ 'dam la sogs par yang phebs/ de rjes byang rgyab brgyud de gung thang dang*/ mang yul skyid grong gi bar du phebs pa la/ de'i bar du mkhas grub chen po skyel mar phebs/ gsung las/ rlung shing rta can dang*/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rm-i lam du zhal lta ba 'di dang*/ mgon po shing phung can gyi gdams pa ste/ gdams pa gsum po 'di ster ba'i yul chos kyi snod du gyur pa gzhan ye ma rnyed nas khyed la gtad pa yin gsung nas/ nam mkha' la 'phur te bzhud kyang zer gar gshegs cha med do/ /de ltar mkhas grub khyung po de ru mtshams dang*/ 'phan yul dang*/ dbu ru stod sogs yongs sdom la lo nyi shu lhag cig bzhugs/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan gyis yang yang bskul te g.yas ru shangs kyi phyogs su pheb nas lo sum cu'i bar 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ sku lus kyi bkod pa brgya rtsa brgyad cig car ston pa dang*/ brag ri la thogs pa med par bzhud pa dang sprul pa'i dmag tshogs bkye nas gnod pa med par pha rol gyi g.yul ngo bzlog pa dang*/ bum pa'i nang du zhag bdun bzhugs pa dang*/ nam mkha' la bzhugs nas tshogs pa khri tshor brgya la byams chos sde lnga gsungs pa sogs rnam par thar pa blos dpog par mi nus so/ /

lan gcig khams pa'i grwa ba 'khrug pas dam sel gyis sku grib phog ste bag tsam snyung ba la/ mgon po'i gtor chen gyis zhes lung bstan byung nas dpon slob bzhi bcu tham pas gtor chen bsgrubs te zhag bcu gsum nas nang rtags byung ste/ gtor ma gtong bar phebs pas gtor stegs kyi steng na mgon po bar chad kun sel nyid sku mdog dkar po zhig bzhugs pa dpon slob thams cad kyis gzigs/ de ma thag snyung ba yang dwangs/ sngon mai tri bas 'khor dang bcas pa la mgon po'i zhal ston par lung bstan pa de 'di yin par grags so/ / mkhas grub khyung po'i rnal 'byor pa des mgon po 'di'i gdams ngag gnang ba'i slob ma ni spyir ni shin tu mang bar yod snang te/ slob dpon chos kyi shes rab la gnad bya ba gcig nas phyis zhu ston hrul po bar du brgyud pa'i yig cha yang 'dug pas mtshon/ 'on kyang da lta'i bar du chos rgyun ma chad cing grags che ba ni gsum yin te mkhan chen la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar dang*/ mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba'i zhang sgom chos seng dang*/ sgyu lus rmi lam gyi mnga' bdag rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus so/ / de las mkhan chen la stod pa ni/ mtshan nyid slob dus 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyi slob ma yin pas nyang stod gnas rnying gi gdan sar spyan 'dren nan can mang po byung ba na/ nga mi chos thag ring bas mtshan nyid pa'i sde chen po 'di 'dzin skyong dka'/ 'on kyang bla ma la zhu dgongs te/ khyung po'i rnal 'byor pa la zhus pas/ khyed rang nyam nga mi dgos pa cig ngas byin gyis brlabs pas dgos don thams cad mgon po 'dis sgrub par 'dug /bla ma'i gdan sa zungs shig gsung*/ der khong gi zhong nas nyung la phebs pa'i lam shang mdar slebs pa na bla ma'i thugs dam mgon po'i bris sku zhig kyang phyi bzhin 'brang kyin byon/ de la 'phur thang du grags/ bla mas bkas ma gnang bar 'khur du mi rung snyam nas slar yang zhor du log te bla ma la zhus pas de spyan drongs la song*/

khyod slob dpon shes rab 'bar bas kyang bsod nams che bar 'ongs gsungs te phyis de kha bzhin du byung*/ mthu stobs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab par mnga'/ 'dis la stod cong chos lding sogs dang*/ nyer gnyis su dgon gnas mang du btab/ 'di nas brgyud pa mgon po rnying pa'i lugs la mgon po stod lugs par grags so/ /rtogs ldan zhing sgom chos seng ni/ mkhas grub chen po khyung po'i rnal 'byor pa yun ring du bsten/ gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag ches zab pa mang po thos/ bla ma'i gsung gis bskul bas gnam mtsho'i ngo la lo bdun/ byang ngur dang thang lha'i mgul sbrags pa la lo lnga bzhugs/ de dus gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du rtogs/ rlung sems dbu mar chud/ yi dam dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang mi lab pa bzhin du gyur/ mgon po'i ched du ma bsgrubs par yang 'grub/ gsang spyod rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad skabs su mthun rkyen thams cad mgon pos bsgrubs/ phyis gnam rtse lding du lo mang du bzhugs te/ gnas de nas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /rmog cog pa chen po ni/ khong gi rnam thar nyid na gsal ba ltar mtha' yas pa'i mdzad pa can yin la/ dam pa 'dis rmog cog gi brag la lo bcu gnyis su mi zas spyan gyis ma gzigs par dka' spyad kyi sgo nas sgrub pa mdzad de/ grub pa'i go 'phang mthon po gshegs pa yin pa las/ sgrub pa lo bdun brgyad song ba'i skabs lha bzhi dril bsgrub la thugs snang 'gro ba zhig byung nas thun gyi nyin mtshan ma chags par mdzad pas nub gcig brag logs la mgon po 'khor bcas mngon sum du byon/ me dpung drag tu 'bar zhing ḍā ma ru khrol khrol 'dug /de gzigs pas thugs nyams 'ur te trag bstod dbyangs su gyer gyin bskor ba mdzad pas mgon po yang shin tu dgyes so/ / de phyin chad chos skyong bran du 'khol zhing*/

mi dang mi lab pa bzhin du bzhugs/ 'on kyang snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bur gzigs shing 'gro drug sems can la byams snying rje phyogs med du shar bas drag po mngon spyod kyi las nam yang ma dgongs te/ dam pa 'di'i 'phrin las rgyas pa'i skabs shig 'bul rkyen tshan che ba zhig nye 'khor lha phu yul ba 'gas bcom/ der grwa ba 'gas ser dmag bshom/ mgon g.yag gcig yod pa mi ngan de rnams kyi grong ltag du song nas rwa bdar rmig pa rdeb ngar skad 'byin pa na me bkra lhab lhab byung*/ der dam pa 'di'i zhal nas/ lam sna bla ma rje la zhus pas lam rgyus mkhas pa'i tshad cig byung*/ zhes sogs mgur pa zhes te/ nga las su chos byed pa la sdig g.yos kyi dmag mi byed/ bsam ngan gyi mthu yang mi gtong gsung nas/ bem bum zhig dang*/ gsol chas bags khug sku rgyab tu bsnams te dgon gnas bskyur/ ri la bros nas byon pas/ grwa ba rnams kyi ser dmag kyang bshol/ dgon g.yag de yang ldog byung skad/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhal bstan nas/ zhe sdang me dpung chen po de/ /byams pa'i chab kyi legs par zhi/ /shin tu legs so rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes ched du brjod pa gsung te/ dpe 'dis mtshon no/ /dam pa 'di'i drung du skyer sgang pa chen pos spyir gdams ngag mtha' dag dang*/ khyad par mgon po'i chos skor gsan cing*/ bla mas kyang mgon po bran du 'khol bar lung bstan/ skyer sgang gi gdan sa mdzad nas 'gro don yang 'phel bar mdzad pa'i skabs shig rtogs ldan zhing sgom chos seng mjal bar phebs/ mkha' 'gro rnam gsum dang*/ a ta ya badz+ra/ mai tri ba sogs nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gdams pa zab mo mang po dang*/ mgon po'i skor sngar rje rmog cog pa la ma gsan pa rnams gsan/ des na skyes sgang pa la khyung po'i thugs sras phyi ma gnyis car gyi gdams ngag rnams gcig tu 'dus pa yin/ dam pa 'di yang byang chub kyi sems kyi mnga' bdag yin pas rbad bskul mdzad pa sogs ye med kyang dgon pa la lcags ri brtsegs pa yul bas bkag

/de nub rang du yul ba rnams nang 'khrugs shor/ mgo bsdu byed mkhan de gnyis 'thab gral du shi ba sogs phyi rtags mang po byung ba zhig yin par snang*/ de'i thugs sras gnyan ston chen po ri gong ba yin te/ skye sgar du bzhugs pa'i skabs tho rengs kha zhig bla ma'i drung du shog gsungs pa la byon pas/ skyer sgang pa gzim khang bskor ba mdzad kyin 'dug /ya ga'i ri ngogs de la ltos dang gsung*/ gzigs pas dgon pa'i ltag gi ri logs la mgon po 'di rngam zhing gzi brjid che bar bzhugs pa la/ gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā las mi snying dmar tsa re ba gnyis 'bul gyin 'dug nas/ 'di ltar gda' zhus pas de tsug yin/ mdang chu skor la ngan byed mkhan zhig byung yod par 'dug te snying ni de'i yin par 'dug gsungs/ nam langs 'phral ltar phyin pas cu skor sgyel 'dug /mi de gnyis kyang 'phral du shi/ de ltar ma sgrub par zhal gzigs pa yin/ phyis yol du bzhugs pa'i dus su nam mkha' nas 'byung ba 'khrugs pas/ thog mda' bcu tsam sku bangs su rgyab pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i ngang nas sku lus me dpung chen po'i dbus su bzhugs/ thog kho rang yang ma nyams/ spu nyag gcig kyang ma tshig pa la thog sde rnams thu bar bsnams te brag yang la byon/ dus der mgon po 'di yang rogs la slebs 'dug ste/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bur shar ba'i stobs kyis bya ba gang yang 'chol mi dgos/ nga la ni dgra dang gnyen la khyad par med/ chos skyong khyed rnams kyis gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /dgos su mi ma bsad cig /ces gtan du ngar chags pa yin/ de yang ji snyed cig 'ong bar 'dug gsung*/ 'on kyang bza' mang tshan nyung tshan gyis chu skor gyi tsam pa skyel ba dang*/ 'tshe bar shom pa'i grwa ba rnams la mi 'tshams pa chen po byung ba dang*/ chu thags ky-i ste sa rku mkhan de ma thag tu ltag pa chag ste shi ba dang*/ lug rdzas skur ba btab pas khrag bskyugs te shi ba sogs bka' shin tu gnyan pa'i rnam grangs la zad pa med/

skabs shig dpal lha mo re ma ti'i zhal na te/ mgon po'i sku zhig bzhengs shig dang sems can gyi don chen po 'ong gsung la/ nga bya btang zhig gis de 'dra ba bzhengs mi thub las che gsungs pas/ lha mo'i zhal nas/ khyed kyis 'jim pa dam spo tsam zhig mi 'byor par 'dug gam gsung*/ 'o na ngas sku bzhengs kyi/ khyed rnams kyis mi ma bsad cig gsungs/ de nas zhag shas song bas lan gcig nye skor gyi grogs po zhig nas 'jim pa'i sa blang te phebs tsa na/ sgo drung na a tsa ra bzo chas khyer ba zhig 'dug /de la gtam byas pas 'jim bzo legs po shes zer bas rten 'brel 'grigs ya mtshan che dgongs te/ nang du spyan drangs/ zhag gnyis gsum rgyu tshogs rnams bsags/ tshon rtsi tshun chad 'dzom pa byung nas bzhengs par brtsam pa las nub mo gra bshom byas nas bzhag pas nam langs ma thag sku yongs rdzogs tshon rtsi dang bcas par grub 'dug /de na re da rab gnas kyi grab ran gsung ba la mgon po'i sprul pa yin par mkhyen nas/ rab gnas khyed rang gis mdzod gsung bas a tsar yang sku 'dra la thim/ de ltar na rang byung mgon por grags shing shin tu byin rlabs che ba da lta'i bar du yang bka' gnyan cing rtags mngon gyur du bzhugs/ mgon po byin rlabs che ba gzhan kun lkog tu yin pa'i tshul du bzhugs kyang*/ 'di ni mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba thams cad 'khor ba mtha' can du byed pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mdzad pa yin gsungs nas da lta'i bar du skye bo thams cad kyis phyag mchod kyi yul du bzhugs so/ / de lta bu'i sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa ni 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa yin/ de yang bla ma gong ma rnams dang mtshungs par shes bya thams cad la ni mkhyen pa rgyas/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i phul du gyur/ 'jig rten chos brgyad las ni thugs log 'khor 'das thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bur gzigs/

gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pa ni 'gyur ba med/ byams snying rje ni mkha' ltar khyab/ yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa ni zhal gzigs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad ni bran bzhin 'khol/ gzhan phan 'gro don rang shar lhun gyis grub pa nyid do/ / de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa de la ni tshogs pa khri tsho mang po 'dus pas/ nub phyogs dza lan+dha ra dang*/ u rgyan tshun chad nas shar phyogs rgya nag gi bar du bu slob kyis khyab par mdzad kyang*/ thugs sras kyis gtso bo gdan sa slob dpon a'i seṅge dang*/ phyogs mthar 'phrin las skyong ba 'jag bsam gyis rkang bzung ba'i sgrub brgyud dpal ldan shangs pa'i srol ka 'dzin pa rnams kyis mgon po 'di'i chos skor rnams ma nor bar thugs nyams su bzhes pas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu'i gdams pa 'chad pa dang nyan pa dang nyams su len mkhan rnams la ma sgrub kyang mgon po 'di rang shugs kyis 'go ba yin/ de ltar gnyan ston nas brgyud pa la mgon po re gong ba'i lugs sam/ smad lugs pa zer te/ ri gong gdan sa las brgyud pa 'di phag mo grub pa sogs dbus su dar rgyas chen po byung 'dug /'jag pa la stod rgyud smad rgyud bar rgyud gsum/ bsam ldeng ba'i lugs la lho gtsang rgyud pa gnyis sogs byung*/ mgon po stod lugs pa'i srol 'dzin rnams la mgon po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum kho na gtso byed cing mthu bo che mang du byung yang byung la mthu chen du rlom pa'i rngams 'jigs byed pa mang du byung zhing*/ sngon dus lugs 'di dar rgyas che/ deng sang chos rgyun ma chad tsam las med do/ /smad lugs pa shangs pa bka' rgyud pa'i skyes chen rnams ni chos skyong tshul bzhin du bsten par mdzad/ nges don zab mo'i rgyud grol bas snang ba sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ rang shar phyag rgya chen po'i yo lang tsam nyid brjod ngo tsam ma yin par thugs la rig pa'i phyir/

khug shog rgyob shogasod shog kyi bzlas brjod dang*/ gzhan la gnod sems kyis dus 'da' bar byed pa'i phyag srol ni med/ sems kyi mdud pa rang grol du shig ge ba'i ngang nas 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi 'bad med du 'grub pa zhig yin par snang ngo*/ / mgon po ri gong ba'i lugs 'di phyis su shin tu dar rgyas che/ chos brgyud kyi sde gzhan du dar ba la rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po 'dis kyang*/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal la gsan/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug dge legs dpal bar 'jag pa'i slob brgyud mos nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa la zhus pa yin/ de dag la brten nas kyang mgon po 'di la mchod mkhan phyogs thams cad du khyab bo/ /ri gong gdan nas brgyud pa'i bka' srol las mkhas grub chos bzang nyi ma byon pa las 'phags chen bsod nams dar dang*/ 'phags pa rim pa sogs kyis zhus te/ 'phags sde bzhi dar ba sogs thor bu thor bur dar ba ni shin tu mang ste smos kyi mi lang ngo*/ / bzhi pa ni/ mgon po'i 'di'i chos skor la rnam grangs mang yang*/ rtog mthu ru sgrub pa dang*/ zhi ba nor sgrub pa gnyis su 'dus/ dang po la sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ mgon po'i sku mdog nag po gtso rkyang*/ lcam dral dang*/ lha gsum dang*/ dregs pa sde lngas bskor ba dang*/ rgyan can lha lnga dang*/ lha bcu gsum pa dang*/ sa ra ha'i lugs dang*/ stod lugs pa'i mgon po lha dgu la sogs pa yod/ gzhan yang ljang gu drag sgrub/ ser po drag sgrub dang*/ lha mo sgos sgrub dang*/ 'khor gyi sgos sgrub dang*/ rten bzhi gnad gsum la sogs pa mchog sgrub pa dang*/ las tshogs shin tu mang bar snang ngo*/ khur dang ldan pa'i rtsod med sha stag yod/ stod lugs kyi mgon po phyag stong spyan stong gi skor mang po dang*/ dbu zhal nyer gcig pa dang*/ rgyud le'u brgya ma dang*/ le'u bcu gnyis ma dang*/ mdo chog la sogs rnams rgya gar nas bsgyur nges pa dka' yang byin rlabs kyi sgo nas chen po yod par snang ngo*/

/ gnyis pa ni/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ mgon po gzigs ldan dang*/ mgon po mthing ga dang*/ mgon po ser po zhal brgyad pa dang*/ mgon ser nor sgrub dang mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po dang*/ mgon dmar tshe sgrub dang*/ mgon ljang tshe bdag sogs mang po yod pa yin no/ /gnyis ka la dgos pa'i man ngag ni/ gnad la dbab pa phyi nang dang*/ grib sel phyi nang*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs sogs yin no/ / gzhan yang lha bzhi dril sgrub dang*/ mkha' spyod gsum sgrub sogs kyang ye shes mgon po 'di dang brel ba'i zab chos khyad par can yin te/ de ltar na 'dir zur tsam smos kyi rgyas par bla ma dam pas ston par 'gyur ro/ /'dir smras pa/ brjod bral ye shes mchog te snying rje che/ /rtag tu shar bas rang rtsal 'gag med las/ /dus gsum chad pa med pa'i 'phrin las can/ /myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs kyi dge legs stsol/ /ces pa phyag drug ye shes kyi mgon po'i chos skor byung tshul mdo tsam 'di yang*/ sa skyong mi'i dbang po kun dga' rab bstan dbang gi rgyal pos bka' bskul te/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha'i ming gzhan kun dga' snying pos bris pa'o// // dge legs 'phel// bkra shis// legs bzhengs de yi mthu las/ /bstan 'gror dge mtshan shar te/ / skal ngan rgud tshogs zhi nas/ /rdzogs ldan chos spyod gyur cig///
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 152 -- PAGE 151 -- PAGE 132 -
